properties.name: dcc.rate-limiter.enabled
properties.description: Whether to create rate limiter beans at application startup.

properties.name: dcc.rate-limiter.fail-open-when-capacity-exceeded
properties.description: Whether to allow requests when the local rate limiter reaches its configured key capacity.

properties.name: dcc.rate-limiter.local.max-bucket-keys
properties.description: Maximum number of local token bucket keys kept in memory.

properties.name: dcc.rate-limiter.local.max-reject-counter-keys
properties.description: Maximum number of local reject counter keys kept in memory.

properties.name: dcc.rate-limiter.local.max-blacklist-keys
properties.description: Maximum number of local temporary blacklist keys kept in memory.
